title: Jerboa's Wake Progress!
author: Content_Mind_196
selftext:
\[FEEDBACK/QUESTIONS/SUGGESTIONS/COMMENTS NEEDED.\]

Jerboa's Wake Is finally done, and here is me beating the game 25%! The UI is still a placeholder but most of the models are done and the dialogue will just use a tiny bit of reshaping!

The game is about earth around 4000 years from now and earth has left and took every single creature with it, but earth has managed to create new life! So your one of the first creatures back on earth, and you make earth green again with your feet!

This is me showing the first biome off, and want some feedback for the game as I want to make this game perfect before even attempting to put this game on itch, so what do you guys think so far?
